name: Vol-regime gate — trade momentum only in a calm volatility regime
rationale: Volatility is regime-clustered (GARCH): returns behave very differently in calm vs stressed vol. This family is a long-only momentum entry whose participation is GATED by the realized-volatility regime — it sizes IN when vol is benign and SKIPS entirely when vol is elevated. The gate is the documented low-vol-anomaly / vol-managed-momentum result (Barroso–Santa-Clara, Moreira–Muir): momentum's crashes happen in high-vol panics, so conditioning on a calm regime keeps the favorable-skew part of the premium and drops the left tail. Entry fires ONLY when (a) realized vol is INSIDE a fitted regime band (op=between → |vol| <= a fitted ceiling: a calm-to-moderate regime, never the panic regime), AND (b) trailing return is above a fitted momentum floor (a genuine up-trend to ride, not chop), AND (c) RSI is below a fitted overbought ceiling so we are not buying a blow-off top inside the calm regime. Exit when the vol regime breaks (realized vol exits the band — a regime flip, signal_exit) or the stop/TP/time-stop fires. The vol band IS the size/skip switch the task asks for; no magic numbers — every threshold (including the regime band edges) lives in param_space and is fit by the Finder grid.
catalyst: Calm volatility regime: momentum's premium is favorable-skew in low vol and crash-prone in high vol — gate participation by the realized-vol regime.
